title: demolish node with no name indexes fields[2] out of range
detail: A typo'd demo line `demolish node` (no name) passes the len(fields)<2 guard, then reads fields[2] — an out-of-range bounds-check panic instead of the strict parser's line-numbered parse error. Crash, not a loud parse failure.
recommended_fix: Require len(fields) >= 3 before the node branch (or check len(fields) < 3 and return a line-numbered parse error), matching every other verb's arity guard.

title: Replay gate hardcodes bare=false — map bare demos always fail the replay gate
detail: parse_demo and run_demo support map bare (run_context_create_bare at main.odin:168-169), but verify_replay and run_replay (replay.odin:155) always replay against the six-node bootstrap map, so a bare demo's blessed log diverges at tick 1 — a guaranteed false 'diverges' failure.
recommended_fix: Thread demo.map_fixture == "bare" into verify_replay and run_replay and pass it to replay_hashes; delete the dead bar variable.

title: harness save silently blesses demos whose expectations/intents failed
detail: On save, fail_msgs (intent mismatches, unapplied intents, never-fired captures, failed expects) are never printed, and return ok || save forces success — exit 0 blesses goldens and manifest from a run that contradicted the demo's own expectations.
recommended_fix: In save mode, print fail_msgs when non-empty and return false so main's 'FAILED during bless' exit path fires; ideally refuse to write the goldens/manifest.

title: Malformed or missing expect window silently coerces to tick-0 only
detail: 'within 100' (no '..') or 'within a..b..c' leaves lo_ms=hi_ms=0; an event expect without any 'within' clause means the same — main.odin:281-282 then matches only tick-0 events, contradicting the strict-parser 'never silent coercions' contract.
recommended_fix: Return a line-numbered parse error when 'within' is present but len(range) != 2, and require an explicit window for event expects (or document the tick-0-only semantics).

title: check_golden leaks the captured frame image on both mismatch paths
detail: The actual image (img) is unloaded only in the else (match) branch; both mismatch paths pass it to save_diff_bundle, which never unloads it — ~3.7MB (1280x720 RGBA) leaked per mismatched frame on the harness's primary diagnostic path.
recommended_fix: Unload img in the mismatch < 0 and mismatch > 0 paths, or have save_diff_bundle take ownership and unload both actual and expected consistently.
